name: spec-dev-kit
description: Spec-driven multi-agent development skills — the spec suite (spec-define, spec-design, spec-build): a verified, production-ready changeset from a one-paragraph idea, via a doc-state workflow graph with role agents, mechanical checks, and one proof-and-delivery pass; spec-review: a portable, gated code review with specialist lenses, independent confirmation of every finding, and an optional fix loop ending in a merge recommendation; spec-discover: the pre-spec front door.
